title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum on 1990-02-25
source: Source:  FOB Master Recording by Ted Mattes and Rick Katzeff using Schoeps CMC4/MK4> Oade> sv-255> clone(1:1); Tranfer: Fostex D-5 (optical)> M-Audio USB Transit> Audacity @ 16/48 (amplified set1 3.9/amplified set2 4.7)> 16/44> CDWave (tracking)> TLH (SBE/Flac16 (level 8)/ffp); Transfer completed August 15, 2014 by jwpetty

ai_review.summary: High‑quality audience recording that captures an inviting, full‑band performance with clear vocals and instrument balance.
ai_review.review: The sole fan review praises this audience tape for its welcoming soundstage that lets the band’s energy shine through.  Vocals, drums, keys, bass and crowd ambience are all present and well balanced, making it an enjoyable listen despite being a non‑soundboard source.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review highlights both the pleasant listening experience and solid capture of band elements, but limited detail on specific songs or performance nuances keeps confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape that “gets out of the way,” delivering clear vocals, drums, keys and bass with ample crowd vibe; no major flaws noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer describes the overall performance as enjoyable and energetic, with good synergy among band members.
